title: Task 2: Integrate and regenerate class-callout rules
description:
Objective:
Integrate class-callout extraction into the importer, extend exact rule coverage, regenerate the canonical SRD pack, and prove the five records exist independently while PR #162 boundaries remain intact.

Files:
- Modify: `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/index.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json`

Steps:
1. Add failing committed-pack assertions before changing importer output. Change `EXPECTED_COUNTS_BY_KIND.rule` from 166 to 171 and add a table of the five expected keys, source locators, and representative body phrases: Wizard p.54 / copying costs 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level; Warlock p.51 / Pact of the Chain; Paladin p.33 / GM discretion for an impenitent paladin; Druid p.21 / sacred plants; Druid p.21 / nature deities. Assert each is `kind=rule`, has string `data.text`, expected provenance locator, and excludes the following class/callout body where applicable. Preserve the existing feature/subclass non-contamination cases.
2. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts`. Expected RED: rule count is 166 and the five rule keys are absent.
3. Import `parseClassCallouts` in `index.ts`. Keep `coreRules`, `spellcastingRules`, and `gamemasteringRules` as a `nonClassRules` array before the Classes slice. After `classPages = sliceSection(...)`, parse `classCalloutRules`, assemble `rules = [...nonClassRules, ...classCalloutRules]`, then call `validateRuleCoverage(rules, input.expectedRuleKeys)`. Do not move the Classes section anchor earlier, because current failure-order tests intentionally slice races/classes after other sections.
4. Add the five keys to `EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_RULE_KEYS`: `rule:druid-druids-and-the-gods`, `rule:druid-sacred-plants-and-wood`, `rule:paladin-breaking-your-oath`, `rule:warlock-your-pact-boon`, `rule:wizard-your-spellbook`. Update comments to describe 127 core + 34 spellcasting + 5 gamemastering + 5 class callouts.
5. Run the focused parser and generated-pack tests. Expected state before regeneration: parser tests pass; committed-pack test still fails because records.json has not changed.
6. Regenerate with `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1`.
7. Review the generated diff. Expected: exactly five `kind=rule` records added, no records removed, no existing feature/subclass body changes, and manifest metadata/count changes only where generated output requires them.
8. Run `npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1`. Expected: zero suspicious records.
9. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseClassCallouts.test.ts packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts`. Expected GREEN.
10. Run `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`. Expected: zero manifest changes, records added/removed/changed all zero against regenerated committed output.
11. Run Biome on `index.ts` and `srdGeneratedPack.test.ts`. Expected: no diagnostics.
12. Commit with `git add packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/index.ts packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/manifest.json && git commit -m "feat(srd): emit class callouts as rules"`. If manifest.json is byte-unchanged, omit it from `git add`.
acceptance_criteria: Importer emits the five exact parent-qualified rule keys with SRD page provenance; total rule count is 171; exact coverage includes all five; canonical pack gains only those records and generated metadata; feature/subclass contamination guards still pass; audit, focused tests, and verify:dnd5e-srd-pack pass; commit created.
close_reason: Integrated five standalone class-callout rules, regenerated exact canonical output, corrected coverage wording; reviews approved and audit/tests/reproducibility verification passed.
